root.title: Diversion vs. Application of Income
root.voice_sync_text: Innu nammal padikunnath Income Tax-ile mikacha oru legal doctrine-ine kurichaanu. Diversion of Income versus Application of Income. Income tax charge cheyyunnathinu munp ee vyathyaasam manassilaakkal valare pradhaanamannu.

points.title: Legal Overriding Title
body: Obligation is created by a superior title or law.
The income never effectively reaches the assessee.
Example: Statutory charge on profit for a specific purpose.
points.voice_sync_text: Diversion ennu parayunnath, income assessee-yude kayyil ethunnathinu munne thanne oru 'overriding title' vazhi vere oridathekku pokunnathaanu. Ithine income aayi kanakakkilla, athu kondu thanne tax kodukkandiyum varilla.

points.title: Post-Accrual Disposal
body: Income first accrues to the assessee.
Assessee then decides to spend or transfer it.
The destination is chosen by the assessee's will.
points.voice_sync_text: Application of income ennal, income aadhyam assessee-kku labhikunnu, athinu shesham ayaal athu swantham ishtaprakaaram upayogikkunnu. Ithu fully taxable aanu.

points.title: Determining Factors
body: Who created the obligation? (Client vs Assessee)

rows: Partner gives share to wife per Decree

points.voice_sync_text: Oru thuka 'Diversion' aano 'Application' aano ennu thirichariyaan chil karyangal nireekshikkanam. Obligation create cheythath client aano atho assessee thanneyaano? Ee difference-il aanu taxability nilakollunnath.
